about.title: About Plyskach — mason in Prague
about.bio_p1: I've been in construction for over twenty years — running my own trade as a self-employed mason (OSVČ) since 2004, with earlier years spent working on building sites as an employee. I started out in Brno and since 2015 I've been based in Prague, where I've built up a steady client base. I lead every job personally, from the first site visit to handover.
about.bio_p2: I specialise in masonry — bricklaying, partitions, demolition — together with related trades: tiling, façades with insulation, plaster and decorative finishes (stěrky), for which I also hold dedicated training. I communicate with clients in Czech and Ukrainian.
about.bio_p3: I work with a small group of trusted colleagues and never take on more jobs than I can handle. What we agree on is what gets done.
about.certs_subtitle: I regularly attend training courses run by manufacturers of construction chemicals. Click any certificate to view the original.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. This document describes what data is collected when you use mykhayloplyskach.com, why it is processed, and how you can exercise your rights under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Czech Act No. 110/2019 Coll.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
paragraphs: The data controller is Mykhaylo Plyskach, self-employed (OSVČ), registered place of business in Prague, Czech Republic, IČO (business ID): 26369524, recorded in the Czech Trade Register. Full identification and registered address can be verified in the public ARES registry at https://ares.gov.cz.
Contact for privacy matters: {privacyEmail}. General contact: {workEmail}.
A Data Protection Officer (DPO) has not been appointed — the obligation under Art. 37 GDPR does not apply to this activity.

sections.title: 2. What data is collected
paragraphs: When you visit the site, log data is recorded automatically by the server and infrastructure providers: IP address, request timestamp, URL of the page, referrer and browser user-agent. This data is used to operate and secure the site.

If you submit the contact form, the data you enter is processed — typically your name, email, phone, message and any attachments. It is used solely to respond to your enquiry and prepare a potential quote.
The site does not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel or similar analytics tools. No remarketing cookies are set.

sections.title: 3. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: The site stores only one technical entry in your browser's localStorage:

This entry is strictly necessary to remember your language preference between visits. It is not used for tracking or profiling and does not require consent under § 89 of Czech Act 127/2005 Coll. on electronic communications.
list: user-locale (localStorage) — stores the selected language (cs / en / uk); validity: persists until you clear it; purpose: user experience.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
paragraphs: Processing of personal data relies on the following legal bases under Art. 6 GDPR:
list: Operation and security of the site (server logs, technical cookies) — Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, legitimate interest in operating and securing the service.
Handling enquiries from the contact form — Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, pre-contract measures at the request of the data subject.
Compliance with statutory obligations (accounting, tax) — Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR.

sections.title: 5. Processors and service providers
paragraphs: The following processors have access to some data only to the extent necessary, under contracts that meet Art. 28 GDPR:
list: Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA — DNS, CDN, reverse proxy and DDoS protection. Cloudflare processes IP addresses and HTTP request metadata as traffic passes through. Transfer to the United States is covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (https://www.dataprivacyframework.gov) and Standard Contractual Clauses.
Hosting provider (cloud infrastructure in the EU) — operation of the site and applications. Servers are located within the European Union.
SMTP / email mailbox provider — delivery of contact-form content and email correspondence to the controller's mailbox. Operated within the EU; access secured by TLS and authentication.

sections.title: 6. Transfers outside the EU/EEA
paragraphs: Apart from traffic passing through Cloudflare (see above), no systematic transfer of personal data outside the EU/EEA takes place. Where such a transfer occurs, it is carried out exclusively under safeguards listed in Art. 46 GDPR (Standard Contractual Clauses) or an adequacy decision under Art. 45 GDPR.

sections.title: 7. Retention
paragraphs: Data is retained only for as long as necessary:
list: Server access logs — typically 7 to 30 days, depending on the provider.
Email correspondence and contact-form messages — for the duration of handling the enquiry and up to 24 months thereafter for potential follow-up; then deleted.
Invoices and tax documents — for the period required by law (typically 10 years under Czech Act 235/2004 Coll. on VAT and Act 563/1991 Coll. on accounting).

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: As a data subject you have the following rights under GDPR:
list: Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR).
Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR).
Right to erasure / to be forgotten (Art. 17 GDPR) — to the extent not blocked by statutory retention duties.
Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR).
Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR) — available only for processing based on consent or contract.
Right to object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21 GDPR).
Right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing (Art. 22 GDPR) — no automated decision-making or profiling is performed.
Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR) — see section 9.

sections.title: 9. Supervisory authority
paragraphs: The competent supervisory authority in the Czech Republic is the Office for Personal Data Protection (Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů, ÚOOÚ), Pplk. Sochora 27, 170 00 Praha 7. Website: https://www.uoou.gov.cz. You may lodge a complaint there if you believe the processing of your data infringes GDPR or Czech Act 110/2019 Coll.

sections.title: 10. Children's data
paragraphs: The site is not intended for children under 16 and their personal data is not knowingly processed. Any such data that may be received inadvertently will be deleted without delay.

sections.title: 11. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This document may be updated over time. The current version is always available at https://mykhayloplyskach.com/en/privacy with the date of the latest revision shown in the header.

sections.title: 12. Contact
paragraphs: For any question regarding personal-data processing, requests to exercise rights, or objections, please contact {privacyEmail}. We will respond within the statutory one-month period from receipt of the request.
